children: reported third-quarter adjusted EPS of $0.65, above the analysts' consensus of $0.60, on revenue of $32.3 billion, ahead of the $31.69 billion estimate. GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations fell to $0.13 from $1.29, reflecting a $2.6 billion non-cash impairment on its Mexico wireless business, which it agreed to sell on October 13. The year-ago figure included a gain on the sale of its DIRECTV investment. AT&T shares fell 5.47% in premarket.

Advanced Connectivity service revenue rose 6.1% to $23.9 billion, and the segment's operating income climbed 18.9% to $7.6 billion. AT&T added a record 769,000 internet customers, including 442,000 fiber and 327,000 fixed wireless, along with 379,000 postpaid phone net adds at a churn rate of 0.92%. Free cash flow came in at $5.0 billion, compared with $4.9 billion a year earlier.

AT&T raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to the $2.40 range and lowered its long-term capital investment plans to $22 billion to $23 billion a year in 2027 and 2028. It still expects free cash flow of $18 billion or more this year and about $10 billion of buybacks in 2026. Net debt rose sequentially to $149.8 billion after the EchoStar spectrum transaction closed.

title: AT&T Stock Falls Despite Raising 2026 EPS Outlook
